nodes.text: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
RAG models outperform a parametric-only seq2seq baseline by 44.2% Exact Match on Natural Questions.
The reported RAG gain is unstable when the retriever is frozen.
Joint fine-tuning of the retriever and the generator is necessary for the reported gains.
The necessity argument rests on a single ablation, and the paper reports no further ablations corroborating it.

Ingest: Lewis et al. (2020) RAG — 44.2% Exact Match gain on Natural Questions vs a parametric-only seq2seq baseline, unstable under a frozen retriever; joint fine-tuning argued necessary from a single ablation
[MITIGATION] The instability-to-necessity inference rests on a single ablation; the paper reports no further ablations or replications, so the necessity claim is under-evidenced rather than refuted.
